decision.summary: A coherent 3D offset initiates ~595–598 (N↑, E↑, U↓), with N remaining elevated, E showing only partial return, and U recovering slowly but not fully by index 604. No clear opposing return observed on any axis within allowed_context [555,639]; thus the interval is uncertain as temporary. The candidate jump at index 593 is inconsistent with the observed multi-sample onset; jump at 601 aligns with E/N reversal but occurs mid-interval and does not complete a return. No evidence of smooth motion or isolated spike—shape supports a single offset event with ambiguous recovery.

intervals.observation: N: sharp multi-sample upward jump ~595–598, sustained elevated level through 604; E: concurrent upward jump, partial return starting ~601 but not back to pre-event level by 604; U: large negative step ~595–598 with slow recovery, still offset at 604. Return on E and U is incomplete/ambiguous within allowed context.
